name: DeltaAssertion
summary: Asserts the difference the exercise made rather than the absolute value afterwards, so that a test survives a fixture it does not fully control.

roles.name: DeltaAssertion
roles.summary: An assertion about a change: one more row than before, two euros more than before. It is what makes a test safe against a shared or prebuilt fixture whose exact contents nobody guarantees — and it is weaker on purpose, since a delta of one says nothing about what the one was.
